title: 第19章 欧皇附体 抽到丹医双绝之华佗第20章 萧氏皇族的大宗正闯宫
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
小侍女灵玉眨动着那双水灵灵的大眼睛，嘴角挂着一抹俏皮的笑意，娇声说道：
“是吖！王爷，您瞧瞧现在您手底下可是一下子多出了这么多人呢？要是再不想想别的赚钱门道，恐怕用不了个把月的时间，
嘻嘻嘻……到时候连奴婢都得跟着王爷一起吃土咯！”
说罢，她还冲萧凡做了个鬼脸。
听到这话，萧凡不禁无奈地叹了口气，心想这小丫头说得倒也不无道理。
确实得赶紧寻摸出一条能够快速来钱的路子才行！
于是，他朝着侍女灵玉挥了挥手，沉声道：“好了，没其他事儿了，你快去忙本王之前交代给你的那些事情吧！”
小侍女灵玉微微弯腰行了个礼，脸上随即绽放出一个甜甜的浅笑，
轻声应道：“那奴婢就先告退啦！”
话音刚落，
她便像一只欢快的小兔子一般，蹦蹦跳跳地跑出了萧凡的卧室。
临出门前，还不忘回过头来，
小心翼翼地将房门轻轻合上。
待到小侍女离开之后，
萧凡依旧坐在原地，丝毫没有起身的打算。
他眉头微皱，右手不自觉地抬起，轻轻地敲击着面前那张精致的檀木桌子，
脑海里则不停地思索着该如何化解当前所面临的困境。
突然，
他灵光一闪，想起就在今日凌晨零点之时，自己似乎签到过不少极为珍贵的宝贝！
说不定其中就有能帮助自己摆脱眼下困局之物？

想到此处，萧凡的心情略微轻松了一些，但仍不敢掉以轻心，
毕竟要将这些宝贝转化为实实在在的钱财，还需要好好谋划一番才行……
记得好像单单黄金就多达整整十万两之巨！
要知道，在这片广袤无垠的大陆之上，
被人们广泛使用且最为常见的货币无非就是黄金、白银以及铜币这三种罢了。
而且它们三者之间的兑换比例几乎固定不变，大致上均是1：100的样子。如此算来，这十万两黄金着实算得上是一笔颇为可观的巨额财富啦！
然而令人惋惜的是，即便拥有这么多钱财，对于目前所面临的困局而言，却仍旧只是杯水车薪而已！
除开这些黄澄澄的金子外，其余诸如各类珍稀的药材、功效神奇的丹药、神秘莫测的功法秘籍以及威力惊人的武技等等物品，无论是其品质还是数量都不容小觑呢？
这些东西自然也是价值连城，如果将它们全部变卖成钱财的话，
想必也能换来数目不菲的金银财宝吧！
特别是那些处于高阶层次的功法，更是堪称无价之宝！
因为一旦得到这样一部高阶功法，不仅能够孕育出一方实力超群的强大势力，还能极大地增强某一势力原本深厚的底蕴！
除此之外，还有一张特殊人才抽奖卡牌。
只见萧凡嘴里不停地念叨着：“特殊人才抽奖卡牌！特殊人才抽奖卡牌！......”
突然，
他像是想到了什么绝妙的主意一般，猛然从座位上站起身来，
并用力地拍了一下自己的大腿，随后便抑制不住内心的喜悦之情，
放声大笑起来：“哈哈哈……倘若本王有幸能够借助这张特殊人才抽奖卡牌抽到一名精通商业领域的奇才，又或是某一种高阶的副职业人才，
比如级别甚高的丹药师之类的人物，那么眼下这缺钱的艰难处境必定能够轻而易举地得以解决啦！”
他长舒了一口气，如释重负般缓缓地坐了下来，心中暗自祈祷，

“天地神灵、玉皇大帝、如来佛祖保佑！一定要让本王鸿运当头！”
在萧凡那无比虔诚且满怀期待的召唤之下，
只见那诸天争霸系统原本透明的面板，此刻竟宛如一面充满着神秘色彩的镜子一般，
悄然浮现在他的眼前。
萧凡瞪大了眼睛，心脏急速跳动，按捺不住内心的激动与急切，
content_en:
The little maid Lingyu blinked her big watery eyes, with a playful smile on her lips, and said softly:
"Yes! My lord, look at how many more people you have now. If you don't think of other ways to make money, I'm afraid it won't take more than a few months.
Hee hee hee... By then, even the slaves will have to eat dirt with the prince! "
After saying that, she made a face at Xiao Fan.
Hearing this, Xiao Fan couldn't help but sigh helplessly, thinking that what this little girl said was quite reasonable.
You really need to find a way to make money quickly!
So, he waved towards the maid Lingyu and said in a deep voice: "Okay, there's nothing else to do. Go and do the things I told you before!"
The little maid Lingyu bent down slightly to salute, and a sweet smile bloomed on her face.
He responded softly: "Then I'll take my leave first!"
As soon as he finished speaking,
She jumped out of Xiao Fan's bedroom like a cheerful little rabbit.
Before going out, don’t forget to look back.
Carefully close the door gently.
After the little maid left,
Xiao Fan was still sitting where he was, with no intention of getting up.
He frowned slightly, raised his right hand unconsciously, and gently tapped the exquisite sandalwood table in front of him.
In my mind, I kept thinking about how to resolve the current dilemma.
suddenly,
A flash of inspiration occurred to him, and he remembered that just at midnight today, he seemed to have signed in for many extremely precious treasures!
Maybe there is something in it that can help him get out of his current predicament?
Thinking of this, Xiao Fan felt slightly relaxed, but he still did not dare to take it lightly.
After all, to turn these treasures into real money, you need to plan carefully...
I remember that the gold alone seemed to be as much as a hundred thousand taels!
You know, on this vast continent,
The three most common currencies that are widely used by people are gold, silver and copper coins.
Moreover, the exchange ratio between the three of them is almost fixed, roughly 1:100. Calculated in this way, this one hundred thousand taels of gold can indeed be regarded as a considerable amount of wealth!
However, it is regrettable that even with so much money, it is still only a drop in the bucket for the current predicament we are facing!
In addition to this yellow gold, other items such as various rare medicinal materials, miraculous elixirs, mysterious skills and secret books, astonishingly powerful martial arts and other items should not be underestimated in terms of quality and quantity.
These things are naturally priceless. If they are all sold into money,
Presumably, I can get a lot of gold and silver treasures in exchange for it!
Especially those at high levels are priceless treasures!
Because once such a high-level technique is obtained, it can not only breed a powerful force with superior strength, but also greatly enhance the original profound foundation of a certain force!
In addition to this, there is also a special talent draw card.
Xiao Fan kept mumbling: "Special Talent Lottery Card! Special Talent Lottery Card!..."
suddenly,
As if he had some brilliant idea, he suddenly stood up from his seat.
And patted his thigh hard, and then he couldn't restrain the joy in his heart,
He laughed loudly: "Hahaha... If I am lucky enough to use this special talent lottery card to draw a wizard who is proficient in the business field, or a certain high-level sub-professional talent,
For example, if someone is a very high-level alchemist, then the current difficult situation of lack of money will definitely be easily solved! "
He breathed a long sigh of relief and sat down slowly as if relieved, praying secretly in his heart.pray,
"The gods of heaven and earth, the Jade Emperor, and Tathagata Buddha bless you! I must let my good fortune take the lead!"
Under Xiao Fan’s extremely pious and expectant call,
I saw that the originally transparent panel of the Hegemony System was now like a mirror full of mystery.
Quietly appeared before his eyes.
Xiao Fan's eyes widened, his heart beat rapidly, and he couldn't contain his excitement and eagerness.
